name: Google Kubernetes Engine
description: A dashboard for Google Kubernetes Engine, from Cloud Monitoring metrics.
details:
## Setup

1. Follow [GCP Metrics Integration](https://docs.kloudfuse.com/platform/latest/integration/kloudfuse/gcp-metrics/).
2. Add `kubernetes.io/`, `prometheus.googleapis.com` and `compute.googleapis.com` to `typePrefixes`.
3. The API server and scheduler panels read GKE control plane metrics (`prometheus.googleapis.com`), which must be enabled on the cluster.

options.content:
The scheduler looks for unscheduled pods and assigns them to available nodes.

High scheduler latency may indicate that the scheduler is having difficulty communicating with the API server or that there are issues with scheduling pods. The schedule attempts metric helps provide context to the scheduler latency.

For additional details on how to interpret and troubleshoot with these metrics see the [GKE Control Plane monitoring guide](https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/docs/solutions/gke/control-plane-metrics#monitor-scheduler).

The API server is an interface that exposes the Kubernetes API and facilitates communication between Kubernetes components.

Abnormally high API server latency may indicate that the API server is struggling to execute its work. Error rate and request count can help validate whether or not observed high latency is problematic or not.

For additional details on how to interpret and troubleshoot with these metrics see the [GKE Control Plane monitoring guide](https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/docs/solutions/gke/control-plane-metrics#monitor-api-server).

options.content:
The controller manager runs controllers that manage the current state of the cluster and work towards the desired state.

Node-pressure eviction is the process by which the controller manager proactively terminates pods to reclaim resources on nodes. High or increasing evictions may indicate that there are issues with maintaining the desired state of the cluster.

To learn more about monitoring resource issues with the controller manager and scheduler, see the [GKE Control Plane Monitoring Guide](https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/docs/solutions/gke/control-plane-metrics#scheduler-resources)

panels.description:
Source Query: top(sum:gcp.gke.node.cpu.allocatable_utilization{$deployment,$statefulset,$daemonset,$job,cluster_name:$cluster.value,project_id:$project.value} by {node_name}, 5, 'mean', 'asc')
top is converted to topk
panels.title: CPU-intensive nodes (%)
